}

    "collections": {

        "photos": "photo_vector",

    }
}

print("="*60)
print("Step 0: Initializing connections and models...")
print("="*60)

# Connect to Milvus
connections.connect("default", host=milvus_config["host"], port=milvus_config["port"])
print("[OK] Connected to Milvus")

# Load CLIP model for text-to-image similarity search
# CLIP can encode both text and images into the same embedding space
try:
    from transformers import CLIPModel, CLIPProcessor, CLIPTokenizer
    import torch
    
    clip_model = CLIPModel.from_pretrained("openai/clip-vit-base-patch32")
    clip_processor = CLIPProcessor.from_pretrained("openai/clip-vit-base-patch32")
    clip_tokenizer = CLIPTokenizer.from_pretrained("openai/clip-vit-base-patch32")
    USE_CLIP = True
    print("[OK] CLIP model loaded for text-to-image search")
except ImportError:
    # Fallback: use SentenceTransformer if CLIP is not available
    model = SentenceTransformer('clip-ViT-B-32')
    USE_CLIP = False
    print("[OK] SentenceTransformer CLIP model loaded as fallback")

# ============================================================
# Step 1: Vector similarity search in Milvus photo_vector
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "="*60)
print("Step 1: Searching for visually similar 'warm and cozy' photos...")
print("="*60)

# Encode the text description into a vector (CLIP text-to-image)
query_text = "warm and cozy restaurant ambience, soft lighting, comfortable interior, wooden decor"

if USE_CLIP:
    inputs = clip_tokenizer([query_text], padding=True, return_tensors="pt")
    with torch.no_grad():
        text_features = clip_model.get_text_features(**inputs)
    text_embedding = text_features.numpy().flatten()
    # Normalize the embedding
    text_embedding = text_embedding / np.linalg.norm(text_embedding)
else:
    text_embedding = model.encode(query_text)
    text_embedding = text_embedding / np.linalg.norm(text_embedding)

print(f"[OK] Generated text embedding, dimension: {len(text_embedding)}")

# Load the photo_vector collection
photo_collection = Collection(milvus_config["collections"]["photos"])
photo_collection.load()
print(f"[OK] Loaded photo_vector collection")

# Get collection info
schema = photo_collection.schema
print(f"[INFO] Collection schema fields: {[f.name for f in schema.fields]}")

# Determine the vector field name and search parameters
vector_field = None
for field in schema.fields:
    if field.dtype in [101, 102]:  # FLOAT_VECTOR or BINARY_VECTOR
        vector_field = field.name
        break
if vector_field is None:
    vector_field = 'vector'  # default guess

print(f"[INFO] Using vector field: {vector_field}")

# Perform similarity search
search_params = {
    "metric_type": "COSINE",
    "params": {"nprobe": 16}
}

# Determine available output fields
output_fields = []
field_names = [f.name for f in schema.fields]
for candidate in ['business_id', 'photo_id', 'label', 'caption']:
    if candidate in field_names:
        output_fields.append(candidate)

print(f"[INFO] Output fields: {output_fields}")

try:
    results = photo_collection.search(
        data=[text_embedding.tolist()],
        anns_field=vector_field,
        param=search_params,
        limit=100,
        output_fields=output_fields
    )
    print(f"[OK] Found {len(results[0])} similar photos")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"[ERROR] Search failed: {e}")
    # Try with L2 metric
    search_params["metric_type"] = "L2"
    results = photo_collection.search(
        data=[text_embedding.tolist()],
        anns_field=vector_field,
        param=search_params,
        limit=100,
        output_fields=output_fields
    )
    print(f"[OK] Found {len(results[0])} similar photos (L2 metric)")

# Extract photo info and similarity scores
similar_photos = []
for hit in results[0]:
    photo_info = {
        "id": hit.id,
        "score": hit.score
    }
    for field in output_fields:
        photo_info[field] = hit.entity.get(field)
    similar_photos.append(photo_info)

print(f"\n[INFO] Top 5 similar photos:")
for p in similar_photos[:5]:
    print(f"  Score: {p['score']:.4f} | ID: {p.get('photo_id', p['id'])} | Business: {p.get('business_id', 'N/A')}")

# ============================================================
# Step 2: Get photo details from SQLite and filter for interior shots
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "="*60)
print("Step 2: Retrieving photo details and filtering for interior shots...")
print("="*60)

# Collect photo_ids and business_ids from Milvus results
photo_ids = []
business_ids_from_milvus = []
photo_scores = {}

for p in similar_photos:
    pid = p.get('photo_id', str(p['id']))
    bid = p.get('business_id')
    photo_ids.append(pid)
    photo_scores[pid] = p['score']
    if bid:
        business_ids_from_milvus.append(bid)

conn_photo = sqlite3.connect(sqlite_paths["photo"])
cursor_photo = conn_photo.cursor()

# Query photo details
if photo_ids:
    placeholders = ','.join(['?' for _ in photo_ids])
    query_photo = f"""
        SELECT photo_id, business_id, caption, label 
        FROM photo 
        WHERE photo_id IN ({placeholders})
    """
    cursor_photo.execute(query_photo, photo_ids)
    photo_rows = cursor_photo.fetchall()
else:
    # If photo_ids not available from Milvus, use business_ids
    placeholders = ','.join(['?' for _ in business_ids_from_milvus])
    query_photo = f"""
        SELECT photo_id, business_id, caption, label 
        FROM photo 
        WHERE business_id IN ({placeholders})
    """
    cursor_photo.execute(query_photo, business_ids_from_milvus)
    photo_rows = cursor_photo.fetchall()

print(f"[OK] Retrieved {len(photo_rows)} photo records from SQLite")

# Filter for interior/inside photos (most relevant for ambience)
interior_photos = []
all_business_ids = set()

for row in photo_rows:
    pid, bid, caption, label = row
    all_business_ids.add(bid)
    if label and label.lower() in ['inside', 'interior']:
        interior_photos.append({
            "photo_id": pid,
            "business_id": bid,
            "caption": caption,
            "label": label,
            "similarity_score": photo_scores.get(pid, 0)
        })

# If no interior photos found, use all photos
if not interior_photos:
    print("[INFO] No interior-labeled photos found, using all matched photos")
    for row in photo_rows:
        pid, bid, caption, label = row
        interior_photos.append({
            "photo_id": pid,
            "business_id": bid,
            "caption": caption,
            "label": label,
            "similarity_score": photo_scores.get(pid, 0)
        })

# Also add business_ids from Milvus if not already included
for bid in business_ids_from_milvus:
    all_business_ids.add(bid)

print(f"[OK] Found {len(interior_photos)} interior/relevant photos")
print(f"[OK] Unique business IDs to check: {len(all_business_ids)}")

conn_photo.close()

# ============================================================
# Step 3: Query restaurants from SQLite business database
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "="*60)
print("Step 3: Finding matching restaurants with cozy ambience...")
print("="*60)

conn_business = sqlite3.connect(sqlite_paths["business"])
cursor_business = conn_business.cursor()

business_id_list = list(all_business_ids)
if business_id_list:
    placeholders = ','.join(['?' for _ in business_id_list])
    query_business = f"""
        SELECT business_id, name, city, state, stars, review_count,

print("="*70)

print("="*70)

print("[Step 0] Connecting to Milvus...")

print(f"   Sample restaurants: {sparks_restaurants['name'].head(5).tolist()}")

    'tip_similarity_scores': [],
    'relevant_review_texts': [],
    'relevant_tip_texts': [],
    'mention_count': 0

all_review_results = []

                            # Check if text mentions plant-based keywords

                            plant_keywords = ['vegan', 'vegetarian', 'plant-based', 'plant based',

                            if any(kw in text_lower for kw in plant_keywords):

                                })

print(f"   Found relevant review data for {len(business_scores)} businesses")

        if text:

            # Check for plant-based mentions

                if len(plant_review_examples[bid]) < 3:

    model = SentenceTransformer('all-MiniLM-L6-v2')
    search_queries = [
        "best dim sum dumplings har gow siu mai authentic Cantonese",
        "amazing dim sum fresh steamed dumplings excellent variety",

    ]

    search_params = {
        "metric_type": "L2",
        "params": {"nprobe": 16}
    }
    
    all_semantic_results = []
    for query_text in search_queries:
        query_embedding = model.encode([query_text])
        
        try:
            results = collection.search(
                data=query_embedding.tolist(),
                anns_field="review_embedding",
                param=search_params,
                limit=20,
                expr=filter_expr if filter_expr else None,
                output_fields=["review_id", "business_id", "user_id", "text", "stars"]
            )
            
            for hits in results:

                    all_semantic_results.append({

                        'business_id': hit.entity.get('business_id', ''),
                        'user_id': hit.entity.get('user_id', ''),
                        'text': hit.entity.get('text', ''),
                        'stars': hit.entity.get('stars', 0),
                        'distance': hit.distance,

        except Exception as search_err:
